doc.title: John Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

title: Billie Holiday's husband John Levy and the poor management
summary: Levy could not get along with Holiday's husband, who mismanaged her career with late pay and no travel arrangements.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: So anyway, we played the concert, did a double thing, two shows. And I stayed with Billie I guess maybe about, about a year. And we traveled. But I couldn’t get along with her husband, who was the same name as mine, his name was John Levy. And we couldn’t get along.
Yeah. And was he managing her kind of?
Yeah. He was managing her career, right. He was managing her career. Mismanaging her career.
Yeah. You could see — you could probably see that it could be done a lot better.

Oh, yeah, and that really ticked me off because everything was backwards, you know. We didn’t get paid on time, and when you had to travel no arrangements were being made for it, and nothing. Everybody was on their own, you know, and I didn’t like it. So
